# Coverage is known only when a test binary ran muxt's template engine:
# each one writes its profile as it starts, before it renders anything.
# A module with no _test.go files runs no test binary, so no profile is
# written and the pre-pass cannot tell which template actions are
# reached. It says so, and every mutant runs. Nothing catches them, so
# each is missed and the run fails.

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
stderr '(?m)^warning: template coverage unknown: no test binary ran the templates \(no coverage profile was written\)$'
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.27
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{if .Admin}} {{.Secret}}{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name   string
	Admin  bool
	Secret string
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
